recent.text: FINAL: Hawks 107, Pistons 97. Led by 11 entering the 4th, then promptly gave up an 18-0 run. Cunningham finishes with 5 points and 15 assists on 2-9 overall shooting. First time this season he failed to score at least 10. Thompson: 18 pts, 11 rebs, 5 assts, 2 blks
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Isaiah Joe hits a 3 at the 4:52 mark for the Pistons' first points of the 4th. Down 92-88 after giving up an 18-0 run. It's not over, but that might've been their worst stretch of the season.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: End of 3rd: #Pistons 85, Hawks 74 The Pistons won the third quarter 33-23. It was their best offensive quarter of the day (12-for-22 FG), led by John Collins, who scored 10 points during the period.
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: John Collins triple. #Pistons take a 72-65 lead over the Hawks with 5:47 left in the third quarter. Collins has 18 points, leading Detroit.

recent.text: Halftime: Pistons 52, Hawks 51. Trailed by 10, then closed the half with an 18-7 run. Held the Hawks to 28.6% overall (8-18) in the 2nd. Still getting crushed on the glass, but the defensive intensity and pace has picked up. Joe: 14 pts Reed: 12 pts Cunningham: 0 pts, 9 assts
